require 'socket'
require 'openssl'
require 'json'
require 'fileutils'
require 'tempfile'
require 'digest'

module DistCache
  class AuthToken
    HMAC_ALGO = 'sha256'
    
    def initialize(secret_key)
      @secret_key = secret_key
    end
    
    def generate(service_id, ttl: 300)
      payload = { service: service_id, exp: Time.now.to_i + ttl, nonce: SecureRandom.hex(16) }
      sig = OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest(HMAC_ALGO, @secret_key, payload.to_json)
      { payload: payload, signature: sig }.to_json
    end
    
    def verify(token_json)
      token = JSON.parse(token_json)
      expected_sig = OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest(HMAC_ALGO, @secret_key, token['payload'].to_json)
      return false unless secure_compare(expected_sig, token['signature'])
      return false if token['payload']['exp'].to_i < Time.now.to_i
      token['payload']['service']
    end
    
    private
    
    def secure_compare(a, b)
      return false unless a.bytesize == b.bytesize
      l = a.unpack('C*')
      r = b.unpack('C*')
      result = 0
      l.zip(r) { |x, y| result |= x ^ y }
      result == 0
    end
  end

  class CacheClient
    CACHE_BASE_DIR = '/tmp/distcache'
    SOCKET_PATH = '/var/run/distcache.sock'
    
    def initialize(service_id:, secret_key:, cache_dir: nil)
      @service_id = service_id
      @auth = AuthToken.new(secret_key)
      @cache_dir = cache_dir || File.join(CACHE_BASE_DIR, service_id)
      @lock_dir = File.join(@cache_dir, '.locks')
      setup_cache_directory
    end
    
    def get(key)
      validate_key!(key)
      local = read_local_cache(key)
      return local if local && !expired?(local)
      
      remote_val = fetch_remote(key)
      write_local_cache(key, remote_val) if remote_val
      remote_val
    end
    
    def put(key, value, ttl: 60)
      validate_key!(key)
      write_local_cache(key, { value: value, expires: Time.now.to_i + ttl })
      push_remote(key, value, ttl)
    end
    
    def invalidate(key)
      validate_key!(key)
      path = cache_path_for(key)
      File.delete(path) if File.exist?(path)
    end
    
    private
    
    def setup_cache_directory
      FileUtils.mkdir_p(@cache_dir, mode: 0700)
      FileUtils.mkdir_p(@lock_dir, mode: 0700)
    end
    
    def validate_key!(key)
      raise ArgumentError, "Invalid key" unless key.match?(/\A[a-zA-Z0-9_\-\.]{1,128}\z/)
    end
    
    def cache_path_for(key)
      hashed = Digest::SHA256.hexdigest("#{@service_id}:#{key}")[0..15]
      File.join(@cache_dir, hashed)
    end
    
    def acquire_lock(key)
      lock_path = File.join(@lock_dir, Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(key)[0..15] + '.lock')
      lock_file = File.open(lock_path, File::CREAT | File::RDWR)
      lock_file.flock(File::LOCK_EX)
      lock_file
    end
    
    def release_lock(lock_file)
      lock_file.flock(File::LOCK_UN)
      lock_file.close
    end
    
    def read_local_cache(key)
      path = cache_path_for(key)
      return nil unless File.exist?(path)
      lock = acquire_lock(key)
      begin
        # Re-check after acquiring lock
        return nil unless File.exist?(path)
        data = File.read(path)
        JSON.parse(data, symbolize_names: true)
      rescue JSON::ParserError
        nil
      ensure
        release_lock(lock)
      end
    end
    
    def write_local_cache(key, data)
      path = cache_path_for(key)
      lock = acquire_lock(key)
      begin
        # Write to temp file then rename for atomicity
        tmp = Tempfile.new('cache', @cache_dir)
        tmp.write(data.to_json)
        tmp.close
        File.rename(tmp.path, path)
        File.chmod(0600, path)
      rescue => e
        tmp&.unlink rescue nil
        raise
      ensure
        release_lock(lock)
      end
    end
    
    def expired?(entry)
      entry[:expires].to_i < Time.now.to_i
    end
    
    def fetch_remote(key)
      token = @auth.generate(@service_id)
      request = { action: 'get', key: key, token: token }.to_json
      send_request(request)
    end
    
    def push_remote(key, value, ttl)
      token = @auth.generate(@service_id)
      request = { action: 'put', key: key, value: value, ttl: ttl, token: token }.to_json
      send_request(request)
    end
    
    def send_request(payload)
      socket = UNIXSocket.new(SOCKET_PATH)
      socket.write(payload)
      socket.flush
      response = socket.read
      JSON.parse(response, symbolize_names: true)
    rescue => e
      nil
    ensure
      socket&.close
    end
  end

  class CacheServer
    def initialize(secret_key:, data_dir:)
      @auth = AuthToken.new(secret_key)
      @data_dir = data_dir
      @store = {}
      setup_data_directory
    end
    
    def handle_request(raw)
      request = JSON.parse(raw, symbolize_names: true)
      service = @auth.verify(request[:token])
      return { error: 'unauthorized' }.to_json unless service
      
      case request[:action]
      when 'get'
        handle_get(service, request[:key])
      when 'put'
        handle_put(service, request[:key], request[:value], request[:ttl])
      else
        { error: 'unknown action' }.to_json
      end
    end
    
    private
    
    def setup_data_directory
      FileUtils.mkdir_p(@data_dir, mode: 0700)
    end
    
    def handle_get(service, key)
      ns_key = "#{service}:#{key}"
      entry = @store[ns_key]
      if entry && entry[:expires] > Time.now.to_i
        { value: entry[:value] }.to_json
      else
        @store.delete(ns_key)
        { value: nil }.to_json
      end
    end
    
    def handle_put(service, key, value, ttl)
      ns_key = "#{service}:#{key}"
      @store[ns_key] = { value: value, expires: Time.now.to_i + ttl.to_i }
      persist_entry(service, key, value)
      { status: 'ok' }.to_json
    end
    
    def persist_entry(service, key, value)
      service_dir = File.join(@data_dir, service)
      FileUtils.mkdir_p(service_dir, mode: 0700)
      file_path = File.join(service_dir, Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(key)[0..15])
      # Verify resolved path stays within data_dir to prevent symlink attacks
      resolved = File.realpath(service_dir) rescue service_dir
      unless resolved.start_with?(File.realpath(@data_dir))
        raise SecurityError, "Path traversal detected"
      end
      final_path = File.join(resolved, Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(key)[0..15])
      File.write(final_path, value.to_json)
      File.chmod(0600, final_path)
    end
  end
end
